translations.web: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.
translations.bsb: You will call, and I will answer; You will desire the work of Your hands.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
